notes.title: SUPER INCURSION REMAKE - PATCH IS HERE, DOWNLOAD NOW !!!
notes.content:
The Patch is finally here, which repairs all previously said issues. I would like to thank all players who played the game and revealed all the issues in need of fixing.

-There's an issue in Chapter 1 with the distance of the text being close to the Code door lock causing UI overlaps
-Purchase of Armour on easy difficulty is suspended
-Purchase of expensive rounds on easy difficulty is suspended
-Enemy weapon and melee damage will increase and decrease varying on whether to you have too many Medi kits and a full health bar. Enemy health has also been increased.
-An issue where you could unlock a power gate without inserting batteries to their receptacles will be fixed
-Complex puzzles will be added to doors to prevent player from being able to leave without fighting the enemies.
-Any updates to enemy ai will also carry over to dogs.

The New Fixed Build is available to download.

notes.title: MAJOR GRAND-SCALE SUPERIOR SUPER INCURSION REMAKE UPDATE IS FINALLY HERE
notes.content:
GRAND SCALE MAJOR UPDATE: The Entire SUPER INCURSION game has been remade using IMS Intelligence Corp's superior files, now it inherits features and bug fixes from that game and DEATH SQUAD, the updated build is now available on STEAM. Update your game to the latest build and play.

All the bugs previously encountered have been fixed.
New weapons from Intelligence Corp have been added: Type-99 Nambu, Rivet Gun, Uniqually Rifle, Uniqually Pistol, Thermal Ninjato, Secondary melee weapons, New additional primary melee weapons like Large Kitchen Knife.
Super Incursion has inherited Special Missions, Survival Mode, UI improvement and upgrades, Improved AI, revamped combat systems, higher resolution textures, reworked animations, reworked environmental 3D objects, better sound design and much much more from IMS Intelligence Corp.

All of the STEAM STORE Trailers and screenshots have been removed and replaced with those that REFLECT the BRAND NEW BUILD OF THE GAME.

THIS IS THE LARGEST EFFORT WE'VE MADE SINCE THIS GAME RELEASED TO MASSIVELY IMPROVE IT, WE ARE EXCITED FOR YOU TO PLAY THIS NEW IMPROVED SUPERIOR BUILD.

notes.title: SUPER INCURSION REMAKE UPDATE IS ALMOST HERE
notes.content:
Super Incursion is being completely redone to fix all bugs and issues, improve level design and add more new mechanics, fix existing mechanics which weren't working properly.

This BIG update is almost here, The rework of the game is 94% complete, the name of the game will change from Lucky Tlhalerwa - Super Incursion to Lucky Pikinini - Super Incursion, all store front trailers will be replaced by new ones, all screenshots will be replaced. 

This is the BIGGEST effort we've made to try and repair this game, cause its got a lot of potential if made right and we're trying to making it right.

This update will bring SPECIAL MISSIONS and SURVIVAL MODE which aren't there on the current build.

We will make a trailer narrating and explaining the mechanics, gameplay, story, weapons, survival mode and special missions. So when you go into the game you go in knowing what's happening and how it works.

This BIG UPDATE will do this game JUSTICE, it will function properly with minimal to no bugs and will be more polished. Better UI, ANIMS, GUN PLAY, AI, LEVELS. ETC.

notes.title: SUPER INCURSION REMAKE TO COME AS AN UPDATE
notes.content:
IMS Intelligence Corp is the current game in development, its 50 % complete here is a gameplay reveal of it on youtube - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xnlpOgYp5UU
We plan to use its GAME FILES to remake Super Incursion, its a super incursion standalone dlc which serves to expand and explain the story where the original super incursion could'int. Intelligence Corp has all of super incursion bugs and problems fixed in it so its easier to remake super incursion using its game files.

This move also comes to align the original super incursion's story with the new story details of the standalone dlcs. So all of Super Incursion's story chapters will be remade, the remake's development will begin immediately after the development of Intelligence Corp concludes. it will take between 4-6 months to remake it.

Benefits of the remake over the original version:

-Better level design
-All super incursion bugs will be fixed
-Superior ui
-It will be playable in 12 different languages as opposed to just 1
-Gun smith which allows you to modify any part of your gun with parts of other guns
-New Special missions mode with 4 maps and survival mode with 6 maps
-Enemy dogs will be introduced
-Better working menus
-All doors will have signs noting the purpose of the room your going into
-6 different types of purchaseble ammo
-Superior AI friend coding and functionality
-Better looking animations and more new animations in general for player and ai
-Subtitles and voice acting for all dialogue
-Gun fight music
-Changing difficulty on pause menu
-Player upgrades with pickups and not XP
-Thermal Ninjato new main weapon which aligns with the story, its carried by higher ranking IMS soldiers
-Improved and fully programmed bombs
-Ability to plant bombs on the floor as traps
-Ability to lift batteries, ladders, boxes
-Pushing objects off your way
-Back laying with ability to shoot while doing so
-More new puzzles like power rerouting.
-AND ALL OTHER NEW MECHANICS AND IMPROVEMENTS FROM IMS INTELLIGENCE CORP

We want to do SUPER INCURSION Justice and not just leave it in its current state but to turn it into a decent and working game so when we eventually make Super Incursion 2, 3 ,and more standalone dlcs, we know the original one is good and playable and we don't have to go back and fix it or worry about it anymore.

We will do a full playthrough of the remake on the official Lucky Tlhalerwa channel after it drops. You will be able to download and play it as just a regular update to the exisiting game, All of the current STEAM store page videos and screenshots will be removed and replaced with the remakes new videos and screenshots, The game descriptions will also be altered. When IMS Intelligence Corp also releases we will do a youtube walkthrough. If you didn't know IMS Death Squad a Super Incursion standalone DLC is out and downloadable right now, We've got an update ready for it and we be getting it up soon for it.
